title: St. Ignatius Cathedral, San Ignacio de Velasco
geometryBasis: The mapped cathedral envelope fixes the plaza front, nave, and the footprint of the adjoining rear volume. The September 2022 public-domain plaza view controls the broad front gable, exterior timber stairs, decorated facade and belfry.
sectionBasis: The plaza elevation provides relative heights and bay spacing. The tower position behind the left roof slope, building heights, side elevations, rear attachment and individual painted details are reconstructed estimates.
limitations: The model depicts the reconstructed cathedral in 2022 and the mapped attached rear range. Decorative painting and wood carving are simplified geometric interpretations.
The rear and side fenestration, bell tower dimensions and gallery framing are estimated from the map and plaza photograph.
The original terrain remains unchanged. The plaza floor and foundation contact down the side slope use approximate vertical registration.
